text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, were you napping during class? When
I looked
over, you were
uncharacteristically still...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! Y-you must be imagining things!
Sleeping
in class is forbidden!
Prohibited! Absolutely not
allowed!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely sentiment... But I saw you
nodding
off, so please stop lying.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Awww... I guess I can't fool you, Grass...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I've been trying to wake up early to get
in a bit
more running, but... now I'm so
sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I suppose I could show you my class notes just this once.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass... Gracias! You have my gratitude!

Appreciation! My deepest thanks!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait, if you're going to show me
your notes,
then I can take a short siesta
during—
